Adzup-Player CLI 1.0.14.0

Usage:
  adzup-player update
  adzup-player update -v <VersionNumber>

Downloads and installs the requested (or latest) player build. If the player
is running, the new build must report healthy or the update is rolled back.

Example:

  adzup-player update -v 1.0.4

commands.payload:
Adzup-Player CLI 1.0.14.0

Usage:
  adzup-player update
  adzup-player update -v <VersionNumber>

Downloads and installs the requested (or latest) player build. If the player
is running, the new build must report healthy or the update is rolled back.

Example:

  adzup-player update -v 1.0.4
